minutes.headline: Board declined to endorse a 35-lot Parmentor Road ANR over Fire Road 15's inadequacy, waiving refiling fees
minutes.summary: The board spent most of the meeting on an ANR for 10 Parmentor Road, ultimately declining to endorse it because Fire Road 15 (proposed frontage for a number of the lots) was found not to have sufficient width, grade or construction, while agreeing to waive filing fees if the applicant resubmits a revised plan within six months. Three smaller matters were continued to January 26 (30 Summer Street, Zero Reservoir Road, and a scenic road application at 1083 Northfield Road), and the board granted a one-year construction extension for the 485 Leominster Shirley Road battery storage project, plus routine committee reports including uncertainty over this year's capital budget funding.

budget_items.what_was_said: The committee submitted its capital plan rankings but noted the board has no clear picture yet of how much money will be available for the capital budget this year, pending the town's finance situation and staffing. Ranking work is proceeding better each year as departments submit more comparable, better-estimated project requests.

budget_items.topic: Storm Water Task Force / bylaw and fee structure
budget_items.what_was_said: The task force is working toward getting stormwater-related bylaws in position for the May town meeting, but said actual rates and financial articles would not be put forward until at least the following town meeting.

budget_items.topic: ANR resubmission fee waiver, 10 Parmentor Road
budget_items.what_was_said: Because the board is not endorsing the 35-lot ANR as submitted, it agreed to waive the filing fee if the applicant resubmits a revised ANR for the same land within six months, so the applicant does not have to pay twice.

what_happened.line: Board voted 4-0 to deny endorsement of the 10 Parmentor Road subdivision plan, finding Fire Road 15 lacks adequate width, grade and construction, but agreed to waive refiling fees if a revised plan comes back within six months.
Board granted a one-year extension of the construction start deadline for the 485 Leominster Shirley Road battery storage project, citing tariff-related delays outside the applicant's control.
Three other matters -- a storm water permit for 30 Summer Street, a storm water permit for Zero Reservoir Road, and a scenic road permit for 1083 Northfield Road -- were each continued to January 26.
Capital Planning Committee submitted its project rankings but said how much money will actually be available for this year's capital budget is still unclear.

why_it_matters: The 10 Parmentor Road denial means any subdivision relying on Fire Road 15 frontage cannot proceed until the road issue is resolved, though the fee waiver lowers the cost of trying again.
Residents tied to the 30 Summer Street, Zero Reservoir Road and 1083 Northfield Road applications will not get a decision until the January 26 meeting.
An unclear capital budget outlook affects which municipal projects the town can fund this year, pending the town's broader finance and staffing picture.
